stem: The moons of the Planet Jupiter were discovered by –
expl: Jupiter is the largest planet of the solar system. The four largest moons (IO, Europa, Callisto, Ganymede) are known as Galilean moons as these were discovered by Galileo Galilei in 1610.

stem: Which one of the following is the heaviest planet of our Solar System ?
expl: The heaviest planet of our Solar System is Jupiter. Its diameter is 142984 kilometers and the average density is 1326 kg/m3. It is also notable that Jupiter is the planet of the solar system that is spining on its axis with maximum speed.

stem: Among the following which planet takes maximum time for one revolution around the Sun?
expl: In the given options Jupiter takes the maximum time i.e., 11.86 years to complete a revolution around the Sun, Earth takes 365.25 days, Mars takes 686.98 days and Venus takes 224.70 days.

stem: The ring of Jupiter is composed of –
expl: The rings of Jupiter were first discovered by the Voyager 1 spacecraft in 1979. These rings are called “Jovian rings”. Jupiter’s rings are supposed to be made up of silicates and dust particles. Due to their sparse and almost transparent nature, it is hard to see them but their existence can’t be assumed to be improbable.
